about: Argon (Ar) is an inert noble gas, about 0.93% of air. It is the standard shielding gas for TIG welding and, mixed with CO₂ or oxygen, for MIG/MAG welding of steel, stainless steel and aluminium. It is also used in steel making and to protect reactive metals during heat treatment.
Argon is heavier than air and can collect in low areas, causing oxygen deficiency. Store and use cylinders in ventilated spaces and secure them upright.
